definition: Improving image quality — brightness, contrast, color, sharpness — via classical processing or learned retouching models.
details: Improving image quality — brightness, contrast, color, sharpness — via classical processing or learned retouching models.

explainer.lead: Image enhancement improves image quality—brightness, contrast, color, sharpness—through classical processing or learned retouching models. It matters for making images clearer or more usable.

tiers.eli5: It is like turning up the right dials on a TV so the picture looks better.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply classical processing or learned retouching models; a pitfall is that pushing brightness, contrast, color or sharpness too far degrades the image rather than improving it.
tiers.paperLevel: Improvement of image quality — brightness, contrast, color, sharpness — via classical processing or learned retouching models.

explainer.example: A dull photograph is passed through a learned retouching model that raises contrast and sharpness.
